/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/BlankTraitPr.name: Genetic Code Template
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/BlankTraitPr.description:
Copies the dominant genes of a pet onto the template. 
This can then be used to increase the chances that traits from the original pet will carry across to a newborn clone.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/BlankTraitPr.descriptionEn:
Copies the dominant genes of a pet onto the template. 
This can then be used to increase the chances that traits from the original pet will carry across to a newborn clone.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/BlankTraitPr.descriptionZh:
把一只宠物的显性基因复制到模板上。
这块模板随后可以被用来增加原宠物将性状带给新生克隆体的几率。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/EggHatcher.name: Incubator Power Core
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/EggHatcher.description: This device facilitates the growth of a Kubrow or Kavat clone, from birth to adolescence.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/EggHatcher.descriptionEn: This device facilitates the growth of a Kubrow or Kavat clone, from birth to adolescence.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/EggHatcher.descriptionZh: 这个装置能让库狛克隆体或库娃克隆体从出生成长至幼年时期。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/Eggs/KubrowE.name: Kubrow Egg
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/Eggs/KubrowE.description:
This egg is used to transplant the genetic code of a Kubrow onto a Kubrow clone.

Location: Kubrow Dens found in Grineer Forests on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/Eggs/KubrowE.descriptionEn:
This egg is used to transplant the genetic code of a Kubrow onto a Kubrow clone.

Location: Kubrow Dens found in Grineer Forests on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/Eggs/KubrowE.descriptionZh:
这个蛋是用来将库狛的遗传密码转移到库狛克隆体上。

获取地点：Grineer 森林（地球）中的库狛兽穴

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetCol.name: Nai-Zhen Kubrow Collar
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetCol.description: A common adornment used to distinguish a Kubrow that is loyal to its master.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetCol.descriptionEn: A common adornment used to distinguish a Kubrow that is loyal to its master.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetCol.descriptionZh: 一个常见的装饰，用以区分库狛是忠于何人。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetFoo.name: DNA Stabilizers
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetFoo.description: Contains 6 DNA Stabilizers to maintain the health of a Kubrow or Kavat.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetFoo.descriptionEn: Contains 6 DNA Stabilizers to maintain the health of a Kubrow or Kavat.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/H.name: The Countessa Comic

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)

The Countessa isn't just an icon—she's a hero! Issues from this cult classic comic series are sought after by subculture enthusiasts who know the value of a strong and stylish protagonist. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)

这是送给线上时代粉丝的终极礼物！用这款必备商品来表达你的热爱和支持，它是任何音乐爱好者的收藏品。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

一套液体放松饮品，非常适合那些肩负世界重担、需要片刻喘息的人。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/H.descriptionZh:
心情水晶造型时尚、美观且令人放松，是送给需要冷静一点的人的完美礼物。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

A nostalgic treat for the ultimate ‘90s kid! Remember those commercials with the cheerful mouse quartet? Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/H.name: 35mm Film
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/H.description:
For the documentarian who sees the world through a unique lens, extra film is always a win. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/H.descriptionEn:
For the documentarian who sees the world through a unique lens, extra film is always a win. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/H.descriptionZh:
对于对世界有独特视角的纪录片制作人来说，影片越多越好。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/H.name: Big Bytes Pizza
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/H.description:
Who doesn't like pizza? Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/H.descriptionEn:
Who doesn't like pizza? Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

谁不喜欢披萨？用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Resources/H.name: Argon Burger Meal

Burgers so tasty they always disappear!

Burgers so tasty they always disappear!

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)

汉堡美味可口，总是一扫而光！

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Intact Sentient Core
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description:
An integral component of Sentient anatomy.  Rarely found undamaged, the specimen may prove useful.

Location: Drops from Vomvalysts on the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) at night, and from Sentients found on Lua and the Veil Proxima
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn:
An integral component of Sentient anatomy.  Rarely found undamaged, the specimen may prove useful.

Location: Drops from Vomvalysts on the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) at night, and from Sentients found on Lua and the Veil Proxima
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh:
Sentient 解剖结构中不可或缺的部分。这种难得完好无损的样本可能有重要用途。

获取地点：在地球夜灵平野夜晚由轰击使掉落，并且在月球与面纱比邻星域由 Sentient 掉落

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Flawless Sentient Core
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description:
A Sentient Core of this quality and condition has rarely been found. Truly a special specimen.

Location: Earned by capturing Eidolons found roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn:
A Sentient Core of this quality and condition has rarely been found. Truly a special specimen.

Location: Earned by capturing Eidolons found roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh:
这种品质和状态的 Sentient 核心极为罕见。真正的特殊样本。

获取地点：通过捕获在地球夜间的夜灵平野漫游的夜灵获得

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Exceptional Sentient Core
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description:
A coveted sample of Sentient internal anatomy. Specimens of this age and quality are both rare and valuable. 

Location: Eidolons found roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn:
A coveted sample of Sentient internal anatomy. Specimens of this age and quality are both rare and valuable. 

Location: Eidolons found roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh:
令人垂涎的 Sentient 内部解剖样本。这种年份和品质的样本既稀有又珍贵。 

获取地点：在地球夜灵平野夜晚中漫游的夜灵

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Riven Transmuter
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description: Combine multiple Rivens to create a new, different Riven.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn: Combine multiple Rivens to create a new, different Riven.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh: 将多个裂罅 MOD 组合起来创造出一个新的不同的裂罅 MOD。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Hemocyte Cystolith
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description:
Torn from the bile duct of a fallen Hemocyte.

Location: Hemocytes found in Plague Star event Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn:
Torn from the bile duct of a fallen Hemocyte.

Location: Hemocytes found in Plague Star event Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh:
从死亡的免疫血胞体胆管上剥落的物质。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）上的瘟疫之星活动赏金任务中的免疫血胞体

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Brilliant Eidolon Shard
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description: Rare shard gained from capturing the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night. Use it to gain Focus or to unbind Way-bound focus nodes.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.longDescription: One of the rarest, most valuable Eidolon shards. Flawless.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn: Rare shard gained from capturing the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night. Use it to gain Focus or to unbind Way-bound focus nodes.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh: 通过捕获在夜间徘徊于地球夜灵平野的 Sentient 所取得的稀有碎片。可用于获得专精点数，或解锁绑定的专精节点。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Radiant Eidolon Shard
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description: Rare shard gained from capturing the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night. Use it to gain Focus.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.longDescription: A shard of unmatched beauty and power.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn: Rare shard gained from capturing the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night. Use it to gain Focus.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh: 通过捕获在夜间中徘徊于地球夜灵平野的 Sentient 所取得的稀有碎片。可用于获取专精点数。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Eidolon Shard
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description: Shard gained from the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.longDescription: The most prized part of an Eidolon. Jewelry created from an Eidolon shard is most prized in Cetus.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn: Shard gained from the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh: 从夜间徘徊于地球夜灵平野的 Sentient 身上所取得的碎片。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Synthetic Eidolon Shard
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.longDescription: An Eidolon Shard synthesized from Sanctuary study.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Quest/G.name: Jahu Gargoyle
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Quest/G.description: A curious blueprint found in the memory banks of Albrecht Entrati's Pom-2.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Quest/G.descriptionEn: A curious blueprint found in the memory banks of Albrecht Entrati's Pom-2.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Quest/G.descriptionZh: 在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的石榴 2 代电脑系统记忆中发现的奇特蓝图。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Shrill Voca
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.description:
A Voidtongue cry, trapped in the stone. Crucial to unraveling the secrets of the Murmur.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionEn:
A Voidtongue cry, trapped in the stone. Crucial to unraveling the secrets of the Murmur.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionZh:
被封印在石头里的虚空语叫声，对解开低语者的秘密至关重要。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Echo Voca
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.description:
The quietest and most elusive of Voidtongue utterances. Sought after but never found by Albrecht.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionEn:
The quietest and most elusive of Voidtongue utterances. Sought after but never found by Albrecht.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionZh:
虚空语中最安静、最难以捉摸的话语。阿尔布雷希特一直在寻找却从未找到。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Bellow Voca
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.description:
The deepest of Voidtongue moans, etched into stone. An unlikely asset in the construction of Albrecht's vessels.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionEn:
The deepest of Voidtongue moans, etched into stone. An unlikely asset in the construction of Albrecht's vessels.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionZh:
被刻进石头中的深沉的虚空语哀鸣。意外地成为了一种建造阿尔布雷希特的承载体的资源。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Entrati Lanthorn
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.description:
A ceremonial beacon used to map Void locations on to real space.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos) and Zariman
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionEn:
A ceremonial beacon used to map Void locations on to real space.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos) and Zariman
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionZh:
用于将虚空地点映射到真实空间的仪式信标。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）和扎里曼号

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Vessel Capillaries
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.description:
A crucial sub-component in the construction of Albrecht Entrati's vessels.

Obtained from Disruption missions on Armatus, Deimos.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionEn:
A crucial sub-component in the construction of Albrecht Entrati's vessels.

Obtained from Disruption missions on Armatus, Deimos.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionZh:
一个阿尔布雷希特·英择谛承载体建造中的关键子部件。

通过完成火卫二卫城区上的中断任务获得。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Events/RoadToTauEv.name: Moonflesh
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Events/RoadToTauEv.description:
Eris, carved up and presented to Praghasa in bite sized chunks.

Obtained from Infested nodes on Eris during Epoch Operation: Taubound.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Events/RoadToTauEv.descriptionZh:
被切成小块献给「布拉喀萨」的阋神星。

在《划时代行动：奔赴 Tau 星系》期间，从阋神星上的 Infested 节点获得。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/JadeShadows/Resour.name: Volatile Motes
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/JadeShadows/Resour.description:
Highly charged particles of pure energy. The source of the Jade Light, and Jade's power. Highly coveted by Parvos Granum for his Jade Eximus program.

Obtained from Operation Ascension missions (Brutus on Uranus) and special Operation Alerts during Operation: Belly of the Beast.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/JadeShadows/Resour.descriptionEn:
Highly charged particles of pure energy. The source of the Jade Light, and Jade's power. Highly coveted by Parvos Granum for his Jade Eximus program.

Obtained from Operation Ascension missions (Brutus on Uranus) and special Operation Alerts during Operation: Belly of the Beast.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/JadeShadows/Resour.descriptionZh:
由纯能量组成的高度带电粒子。这些粒子是翠玉之光及 Jade 力量的来源，帕尔沃斯·格拉努为了他的翠玉卓越者项目非常渴求这些粒子。

通过完成行动扬升任务（天王星的布鲁图斯）和《行动代号：兽之腹》的特殊行动警报获得。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/JadeShadows/Resour.name: Vestigial Motes
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/JadeShadows/Resour.description:
Remnants of Jade's light. Echoes of her power.

Obtained from Ascension missions on Brutus, Uranus.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/JadeShadows/Resour.descriptionEn:
Remnants of Jade's light. Echoes of her power.

Obtained from Ascension missions on Brutus, Uranus.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/JadeShadows/Resour.descriptionZh:
Jade 之光的残留。她力量的回响。

通过完成天王星布鲁图斯节点上的扬升任务获得。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/NarmerSorties/Arch.name: ARCHON SHARD
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/NarmerSorties/Arch.description: A source of anti-entropic radiation ideal for empowering synthetic lifeforms, most notably Archons and Warframes.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/NarmerSorties/Arch.descriptionEn: A source of anti-entropic radiation ideal for empowering synthetic lifeforms, most notably Archons and Warframes.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/NarmerSorties/Arch.descriptionZh: 一种反熵辐射来源，用于强化合成生命体，尤其是执刑官和战甲。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Shadowgrapher/Reso.name: Nightmare Tatters
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Shadowgrapher/Reso.description:
The ragged remnants of hopes and dreams can be recreated with patient persistence.

Obtained by completing Follie's Hunt missions on Vesper Relay and Nightmare missions during Operation: Atramentum.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Shadowgrapher/Reso.descriptionEn:
The ragged remnants of hopes and dreams can be recreated with patient persistence.

Obtained by completing Follie's Hunt missions on Vesper Relay and Nightmare missions during Operation: Atramentum.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Shadowgrapher/Reso.descriptionZh:
希望与梦想的残缺碎片，终能通过耐心与坚持重获新生。

通过在《行动代号：墨痕》期间完成 Vesper 中继站的 Follie 的狩猎任务和噩梦任务获得。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Shadowgrapher/Reso.name: Atramentum
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Shadowgrapher/Reso.description:
This deep black ink has the power to reveal hidden truth.

Obtained from Atramentum Balloons and completing Follie's Hunt missions (Vesper Relay). Exchanged with Aspirant Zorba in any Relay.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Shadowgrapher/Reso.descriptionEn:
This deep black ink has the power to reveal hidden truth.

Obtained from Atramentum Balloons and completing Follie's Hunt missions (Vesper Relay). Exchanged with Aspirant Zorba in any Relay.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Shadowgrapher/Reso.descriptionZh:
这种深黑色的墨水拥有揭示隐藏真相的力量。

通过墨痕气球，以及完成 Follie 的狩猎任务获得（Vesper 中继站）。前往任意中继站，在见习仲裁者左巴处使用墨痕兑换物品。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.name: Ignia
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.description:
The passionate heat of flames fuels the path to redemption.

Location: Obtained from crates and bosses in the Descendia (Dark Refractory).
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.descriptionEn:
The passionate heat of flames fuels the path to redemption.

Location: Obtained from crates and bosses in the Descendia (Dark Refractory).
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.descriptionZh:
炽热的火焰点燃了救赎之路。

获取地点：从沉沦之地（深溯池）的箱子和头目处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.name: Maphica
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.description:
A core of rage, jealously guarded in a burnished shell.

Location: Obtained from crates and bosses in the Descendia (Dark Refractory).
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.descriptionEn:
A core of rage, jealously guarded in a burnished shell.

Location: Obtained from crates and bosses in the Descendia (Dark Refractory).
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/CoHR.descriptionZh:
愤怒的核心，被小心翼翼地守护在光洁的外壳之下。

获取地点：从沉沦之地（深溯池）的箱子和头目处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.name: Ren Hypercore
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.description:
The evolved core of a Dactolyst, bearing its true self-given name and identity. When deprived of Tau pollen, the core becomes susceptible to forcible reprogramming.

Obtained from Recall: Dactolyst missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.descriptionEn:
The evolved core of a Dactolyst, bearing its true self-given name and identity. When deprived of Tau pollen, the core becomes susceptible to forcible reprogramming.

Obtained from Recall: Dactolyst missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.descriptionZh:
这是指节使进化后的核心，承载着其真正自创的名字和身份。当 Tau 花粉供给中断时，这个核心就容易被强制重编程。

可从佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）中的'回忆：指节使'任务中获取。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.name: Lyroic Bridge
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.description:
A delicate paraneural interface allowing a duly evolved Sentient pilot to command the colossal Hunhullus as if it were a second skin.

Obtained from Recall: Hunhullus missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.descriptionEn:
A delicate paraneural interface allowing a duly evolved Sentient pilot to command the colossal Hunhullus as if it were a second skin.

Obtained from Recall: Hunhullus missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.descriptionZh:
一种精妙的外神经接口，使经过适当进化的 Sentient 飞行员能够像操控第二层皮肤一样操控庞大的英魂统使。

可从佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）中的'回忆：英魂统使'任务中获取。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.name: Ascaris Prime
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.description:
Technology developed by Executor Ballas to allow remote piloting of a hijacked Warframe for short periods, forcing them to act against even their deepest instincts.

Obtained from Recall: Vanguard missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.descriptionEn:
Technology developed by Executor Ballas to allow remote piloting of a hijacked Warframe for short periods, forcing them to act against even their deepest instincts.

Obtained from Recall: Vanguard missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Tau/Resources/Twel.descriptionZh:
由执行者 Ballas 开发的技术，可对被劫持的战甲进行短时间的远程操控，迫使他们违背自己最深层的本能行事。

可从佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）中的'回忆：先锋'任务中获取。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.name: Entropic Kuva
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.description:
A dangerous and erratic type of Kuva.

Obtained from Entropic Eximus in Zariman missions.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.descriptionZh:
一种危险且不稳定的赤毒。

在扎里曼任务中从熵之卓越者获得。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.name: Voidplume Pinion
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.description:
A Void Angel's living feather, ripped out in combat.

Location: Zariman
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.longDescription: The most prized part of an Eidolon. Jewelry created from an Eidolon shard is most prized in Cetus.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.descriptionEn:
A Void Angel's living feather, ripped out in combat.

Location: Zariman
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.descriptionZh:
一根来自虚空天使的鲜活羽毛，在战斗中被扯了下来。

获取地点：扎里曼号

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.name: Voidplume Quill
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.description:
A symbol of genius, fallen from Void Angels long ago.

Location: Zariman
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.descriptionEn:
A symbol of genius, fallen from Void Angels long ago.

Location: Zariman
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.descriptionZh:
天才的象征，很久以前就从虚空天使身上掉落了。

获取地点：扎里曼号

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.name: Voidplume Down
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.description:
Barbed and half-real, shed by a Void Angel.

Location: Zariman
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.descriptionEn:
Barbed and half-real, shed by a Void Angel.

Location: Zariman
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.descriptionZh:
带刺且半真实，从一位虚空天使脱落。

获取地点：扎里曼号

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.name: Voidplume Crest
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.description:
The fine plumes from a Void Angel's crown.

Location: Zariman
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.descriptionEn:
The fine plumes from a Void Angel's crown.

Location: Zariman
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.descriptionZh:
虚空天使王冠上的精美羽毛。

获取地点：扎里曼号

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.name: Voidplume Vane
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.description:
A metallic plume from a Void Angel's wing.

Location: Zariman
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.descriptionEn:
A metallic plume from a Void Angel's wing.

Location: Zariman
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.descriptionZh:
虚空天使翅膀上的一片金属羽毛。

获取地点：扎里曼号

/Lotus/Types/Items/DangerRoom/DangerRoom.name: Mall Rotunda Simulacrum

/Lotus/Types/Items/DangerRoom/DangerRoom.descriptionEn: Simulate a battle in a Techrot-choked Mall beneath Höllvania. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
/Lotus/Types/Items/DangerRoom/DangerRoom.descriptionZh: 在充满了科腐者的霍瓦尼亚商场地底模拟战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。

/Lotus/Types/Items/DangerRoom/DangerRoom.name: Höllvanian Courtyard Simulacrum

/Lotus/Types/Items/DangerRoom/DangerRoom.name: Sanctum Simulacrum

/Lotus/Types/Items/DangerRoom/DangerRoom.descriptionEn: Stage a battle in your enemy's arena for deeper insight into their tactics. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.

/Lotus/Types/Items/DangerRoom/DangerRoom.name: Orokin Derelict Simulacrum

/Lotus/Types/Items/DangerRoom/DangerRoom.nameZh: 智踱恐鸟竞技场幻影装置

/Lotus/Types/Items/Eidolon/InfestedEvent.name: Infested Catalyst
/Lotus/Types/Items/Eidolon/InfestedEvent.description:
This refined toxin catalyst has been formulated to reinforce the Thrax Toxin and maximize damage to the Infested boil in Plague Star bounties.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/InfestedR.description: These specimens were originally parasites, breeding inside the wyrm-guts of Fass and scattered across Deimos in the debris of his explosive demise. They are drawn to his light.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/InfestedU.description: These hefty fish are cannibalistic. They rise by Vome's light to absorb rare gases, retreating when Fass ascends to devour their smaller kin in their lairs.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/OrokinLeg.name: Myxostomata
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/OrokinLeg.description: This exceptionally rare breed of fish is almost extinct, as its gilded Orokin flesh has a special savor for predators. It warily conceals itself in caves.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/OrokinRar.description: A living fossil hearkening back to the Orokin era, this elusive fish hides below the surface of Exocrine pools in the deepest caverns it can find. Unlike Infested fish breeds, it has no ability to hover.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/OrokinUnc.name: Chondricord
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/OrokinUnc.description: A triumph of Orokin bio-engineering, these hardy fish have adapted to the Deimos environment and seem oddly resistant to Infestation. They thrive in cave environments.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/OrokinUnc.descriptionEn: A triumph of Orokin bio-engineering, these hardy fish have adapted to the Deimos environment and seem oddly resistant to Infestation. They thrive in cave environments.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/OrokinUnc.descriptionZh: 一项奥罗金生物工程技术的胜利，这些坚毅的鱼类已经适应了火卫二的环境，并且似乎对感染者有着奇怪的抵抗力。它们在洞穴环境中茁壮成长。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.name: Inaak
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.description: Some theorize that Duviri stands upon the shell of a giant Inaak. Naturally, some wonder what the giant Inaak stands upon. The answer, of course, is other Inaaks, all the way down.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.descriptionEn: Some theorize that Duviri stands upon the shell of a giant Inaak. Naturally, some wonder what the giant Inaak stands upon. The answer, of course, is other Inaaks, all the way down.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.descriptionZh: 有些理论认为，双衍王境坐落在一只巨大的载世龟壳上。自然而然地，一些人会想知道巨大的载世龟是站在什么之上的。答案当然是其他载世龟，一个接一个叠到底部。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.name: Xiran
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.description: The Golden Maw finds Xirans exceptionally delicious.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.descriptionEn: The Golden Maw finds Xirans exceptionally delicious.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.descriptionZh: 黄金喉兽发现息壤鲳特别美味。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.name: Haav
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.description: Haav prefer to swim near the surface. Duviri citizens often mistake them for logs, which can be startling when Haav show their fangs.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.descriptionEn: Haav prefer to swim near the surface. Duviri citizens often mistake them for logs, which can be startling when Haav show their fangs.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.descriptionZh: 浮伤鱼喜欢在靠近水面的地方游。双衍王境的公民经常把它们误认为木头，当浮伤鱼露出它们的尖牙时，可能会让人大吃一惊。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.name: Namaes
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.description: The Namaes has evolved the ability to tense its tail muscles and use its tail as a fearsome weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.descriptionEn: The Namaes has evolved the ability to tense its tail muscles and use its tail as a fearsome weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.descriptionZh: 纳土鲉已经进化出收紧尾部肌肉的能力，并把它的尾巴当成一种可怕的武器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.name: Seonn
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.description: The Seonn's ability to flare its neck and hood makes it impossible for most predators to swallow, but the Golden Maw can overcome its defense.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.descriptionEn: The Seonn's ability to flare its neck and hood makes it impossible for most predators to swallow, but the Golden Maw can overcome its defense.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Duviri/DuviriFis.descriptionZh: 精灵鱼的颈部和头鳍可以伸展，让大多数的捕食者无法吞咽，但是黄金喉兽可以攻克它的防御。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/BothComm.name: Charc Eel
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/BothComm.description: Discharges electricity from luminous glands along its flanks to stun its prey.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/BothComm.descriptionEn: Discharges electricity from luminous glands along its flanks to stun its prey.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/BothComm.descriptionZh: 从它侧腹的发光腺体中释放出电流将它的猎物击晕。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/DayUncom.description: Displays blood-spattered pattern on its scales and has its ribs exposed through open cavities along both flanks. When predators approach it lies still at the bottom of the sand banks, disguised as a carcass in hopes of being ignored.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/GrineerB.name: Boot
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/GrineerB.description: Synthetic fibers and a molded foam insole were the basis for what was once a robust and comfortable combat boot. Now, it's a home for tiny aquatic organisms.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/GrineerB.descriptionEn: Synthetic fibers and a molded foam insole were the basis for what was once a robust and comfortable combat boot. Now, it's a home for tiny aquatic organisms.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/GrineerB.descriptionZh: 合成纤维与注塑泡沫制成了的鞋垫，曾经它是一只强韧、舒适的战斗靴。如今，它是小型水生生物体的家。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/HolidayG.name: STOCKING
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/HolidayG.description: You're catching a lot of these. Are you stocking up?

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/HolidayG.descriptionZh: 你捕获了很多这玩意。你是在囤货吗？

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/NightLeg.name: Glappid
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/NightLeg.description: The Glappid is a scavenger that feasts on the remains of dead fish. It has formed a symbiotic bond with the Seram Beetle which extracts and feeds upon any toxins ingested by the Glappid.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/NightLeg.descriptionEn: The Glappid is a scavenger that feasts on the remains of dead fish. It has formed a symbiotic bond with the Seram Beetle which extracts and feeds upon any toxins ingested by the Glappid.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/NightLeg.descriptionZh: 盖拉佩德是一种以死鱼残骸为生的食腐动物。它与瑟拉姆甲虫形成了一种共生关系，甲虫将盖拉佩德摄入的毒素析出并以之为食。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/1999Conques.name: Pix Chip
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/1999Conques.description:

Location: Elite Temporal Archimedea (Höllvania) and duplicate Peely Pix.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/1999Conques.descriptionEn:
Kaya Velasco in the Höllvania Mall accepts these Pix Chips in exchange for Peely Paks.

Location: Elite Temporal Archimedea (Höllvania) and duplicate Peely Pix.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/1999Conques.descriptionZh:
霍瓦尼亚中央商场的卡娅·维拉斯科收取这些贴纸芯片，提供易撕贴纸包。

获取地点：精英时光科研（霍瓦尼亚）和重复的易撕贴纸。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/CodaWeaponB.name: Live Heartcell
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/CodaWeaponB.description:
Harvested from the still beating heart of a Technocyte Coda.

Location: Earned upon Vanquishing a Technocyte Coda in Höllvania.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/CodaWeaponB.descriptionEn:
Harvested from the still beating heart of a Technocyte Coda.

Location: Earned upon Vanquishing a Technocyte Coda in Höllvania.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/CodaWeaponB.descriptionZh:
从科技细胞终幕者仍在跳动的心脏中采集。

获取地点：消灭科技细胞终幕者。（霍瓦尼亚）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DangerRoomK.name: Simulacrum Access Key
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DangerRoomK.description:
Grants access to the Simulacrum.

In the Simulacrum you can face mimeographs of enemies you have fully researched with the Codex.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DangerRoomK.descriptionEn:
Grants access to the Simulacrum.

In the Simulacrum you can face mimeographs of enemies you have fully researched with the Codex.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DangerRoomK.descriptionZh:
授权使用幻影装置

在幻影装置中你可以迎战已经调查完毕并写入数据库的敌方单位复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DuviriGuidi.name: Enigma Sense
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DuviriGuidi.description: Nearby Duviri Enigmas will be marked with a waypoint.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DuviriGuidi.descriptionEn: Nearby Duviri Enigmas will be marked with a waypoint.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DuviriGuidi.descriptionZh: 附近的双衍王境奥理将标注为标记点。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensGr.name: Greater Focus Lens
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensGr.description: A Greater Lens that channels Affinity into Focus for one of the five Tenno Ways.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensGr.descriptionEn: A Greater Lens that channels Affinity into Focus for one of the five Tenno Ways.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensGr.descriptionZh: 一颗将经验值转换为五项 Tenno 之道专精的高级晶体。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensLu.name: Lua Lens
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensLu.description: An Eidolon Lens enhanced with resonance from Somatic Fibers.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensLu.descriptionEn: An Eidolon Lens enhanced with resonance from Somatic Fibers.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensLu.descriptionZh: 一颗通过活体纤维的共振来强化的夜灵晶体。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensOs.name: Eidolon Lens
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensOs.description: An enhanced Greater Lens that has been infused with Breath of the Eidolon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensOs.descriptionEn: An enhanced Greater Lens that has been infused with Breath of the Eidolon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensOs.descriptionZh: 一颗注入了夜灵之息的强化高级晶体。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FoilModUnlo.name: Chromatic Atramentum
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FoilModUnlo.description:
Turns a conventional mod into a work of art. An Atragraph Mod.

Find Aspirant Zorba on a relay to create Atragraph Mods.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FoilModUnlo.descriptionEn:
Turns a conventional mod into a work of art. An Atragraph Mod.

Find Aspirant Zorba on a relay to create Atragraph Mods.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FoilModUnlo.descriptionZh:
将传统 Mod 变成艺术品。墨染 Mod。

在一个中继站找到见习仲裁者左巴即可制作墨染 Mod。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Forma.name: Forma
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Forma.description: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Forma.descriptionEn: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Forma.descriptionZh: 这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的。可以改变战甲、同伴或武器的极性槽，并将等级重置为无等级。只能用于满级的战甲、同伴及武器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaAura.name: Omni Forma
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaAura.description:
Modifies any slot to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.

*Umbra Polarity not included.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaAura.descriptionEn:
Modifies any slot to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.

*Umbra Polarity not included.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaAura.descriptionZh:
改变任何槽位以与任何 Mod 极性兼容。

*不包括 Umbra 极性。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaOmega.name: TEST FORMA
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaOmega.description: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaOmega.descriptionEn: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaOmega.descriptionZh: 这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的。可以改变战甲、同伴或武器的极性槽，并将等级重置为无等级。只能用于满级的战甲、同伴及武器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaStance.name: Stance Forma
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaStance.description: Modifies a Stance slot on a melee weapon to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaStance.descriptionEn: Modifies a Stance slot on a melee weapon to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaStance.descriptionZh: 改变近战武器上的架式槽位以与任何 Mod 的极性相容。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaUmbra.name: Umbra Forma
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaUmbra.description:
Forma that can apply the UMBRA polarity.

This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe or Melee Weapon to UMBRA polarity and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes and Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaUmbra.descriptionEn:
Forma that can apply the UMBRA polarity.

This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe or Melee Weapon to UMBRA polarity and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes and Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaUmbra.descriptionZh:
可以设置 UMBRA 极性的 Forma。

这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的基础构件。它可以改变战甲或武器的极性槽至 UMBRA 极性，并将其等级重置为无等级。这项物品只能用于满级的战甲及近战武器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GranumBucks.name: Corrupted Holokey
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GranumBucks.description: A corrupted decryption key dating back to the founding of the city of Corposium. Millions of these Holokeys were lost to the Void when Parvos Granum's flagship was bombed. Strongly desired by Ergo Glast.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GranumBucks.descriptionEn: A corrupted decryption key dating back to the founding of the city of Corposium. Millions of these Holokeys were lost to the Void when Parvos Granum's flagship was bombed. Strongly desired by Ergo Glast.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GranumBucks.descriptionZh: 一把堕落解密钥匙，起源可以追溯到 Corposium 之城建立的时期。当帕尔沃斯·格拉努的旗舰被炸毁时，数以百万计这样的全息密钥就失落在了虚空中。Ergo Glast 对这件物品情有独钟。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GrnFlameSpe.name: Javlok Capacitor
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GrnFlameSpe.description: Used in the construction of Javloks
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GrnFlameSpe.descriptionEn: Used in the construction of Javloks

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/HeavyWeapon.name: Gravimag
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/HeavyWeapon.description:
Allows archwing guns to be deployed in terrestrial zones. Install this device on archwing guns to compensate for atmospheric and gravitational forces not experienced in space.
NOTE: Deployment requires gear obtained from the Profit-Taker mission in Fortuna.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/HeavyWeapon.descriptionEn:
Allows archwing guns to be deployed in terrestrial zones. Install this device on archwing guns to compensate for atmospheric and gravitational forces not experienced in space.
NOTE: Deployment requires gear obtained from the Profit-Taker mission in Fortuna.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/HeavyWeapon.descriptionZh:
允许曲翼枪械在陆地区域使用。陆地环境中存在着太空环境所没有的大气压力与重力，在曲翼枪械上安装这个装置就能抵消上述差异所带来的绝大部分影响。
注意：在部署时需要用到福尔图娜的利润收割者任务中取得的道具。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Ack & Brunt Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to send forth a spectral axe during aerial and slide attacks in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.nameZh: 认知 & 冲击灵化之源
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.descriptionEn: Awaken this weapon's ability to send forth a spectral axe during aerial and slide attacks in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.descriptionZh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下重击具有在空中和滑行攻击时发出一把光谱战斧的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Anku Incarnon Genesis

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.name: Cross-Matrix Widget
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.description: Chance for each scan with the Synthesis Scanner to count as two scans.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.descriptionEn: Chance for each scan with the Synthesis Scanner to count as two scans.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.descriptionZh: 每次以结合扫描器执行扫描时，有几率进行二次扫描。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.description: Synthesis Scanner will now show target enemy weaknesses and resistances.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.descriptionZh: 结合扫描器将显示目标敌人的弱点和抗性。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.name: Vector-Thread Widget
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.description: Reduces the time required to scan a target with the Synthesis Scanner.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.descriptionZh: 降低结合扫描器扫描目标所需的时间。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MechSurviva.name: Phasic Cells
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MechSurviva.description: Harvested from the debris left by fallen Orphix Sentients, Phasic Cells seem to be key to pulse function. These components can be traded with Father in the Necralisk.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MechSurviva.descriptionEn: Harvested from the debris left by fallen Orphix Sentients, Phasic Cells seem to be key to pulse function. These components can be traded with Father in the Necralisk.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MechSurviva.descriptionZh: 从战败的 Sentient 奥影母艇残骸中收集而来，相位电池似乎是脉冲功能的关键。在殁世幽都中，可以与'父亲'交易这些组件。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ModSlotUnlo.name: additional mod config slot for this item
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ModSlotUnlo.description: Unlocks an additional appearance config slot for this item, up to a maximum of 3 extra slots.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ModSlotUnlo.nameEn: additional mod config slot for this item
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ModSlotUnlo.nameZh: 为这件物品解锁额外的 MOD 配置槽位
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ModSlotUnlo.descriptionEn: Unlocks an additional appearance config slot for this item, up to a maximum of 3 extra slots.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ModSlotUnlo.descriptionZh: 为这个物品解锁 1 个额外的外观配置槽位，最多 3 个额外槽位。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MushroomFoo.name: Fergolyte
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MushroomFoo.description:
This highly reactive mineral deposit is the only substance known to make The Prince grow.

Location: The Deepmines below Fortuna, Venus.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MushroomFoo.descriptionEn:
This highly reactive mineral deposit is the only substance known to make The Prince grow.

Location: The Deepmines below Fortuna, Venus.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MushroomFoo.descriptionZh:
这种高反应性的矿藏是已知唯一能让王子菇成长的物质。

获取地点：金星福尔图娜下方的深矿。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCatal.name: Orokin Catalyst
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCatal.description: Orokin modification technology used to super-charge weaponry. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCatal.descriptionEn: Orokin modification technology used to super-charge weaponry. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Weapon.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinReact.description: Reactor used to super-charge Warframes. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Warframe, Archwing, and Companions.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinReact.descriptionEn: Reactor used to super-charge Warframes. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Warframe, Archwing, and Companions.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/PrimeBucks.name: Orokin Ducats
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/PrimeBucks.description: Currency exchanged for Prime components and used to purchase items from the Void Trader.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/PrimeBucks.descriptionEn: Currency exchanged for Prime components and used to purchase items from the Void Trader.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/PrimeBucks.descriptionZh: 由Prime部件兑换的货币，可用于在虚空商人处购买商品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenIdenti.name: Veiled Riven Cipher
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenIdenti.description: Use this cipher to instantly complete one Veiled Riven Challenge at the cost of consuming the cipher.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenIdenti.descriptionEn: Use this cipher to instantly complete one Veiled Riven Challenge at the cost of consuming the cipher.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenIdenti.descriptionZh: 使用并消耗破解器即可立即完成一项尚未揭开的裂罅 Mod 挑战。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SchismKey.name: Aya
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SchismKey.description:
Raw Orokin memory plasma. Varzia's Foundry can consume Aya to create Void Relics. Find her in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars.

Location: Void Missions and Bounties
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SchismKey.descriptionEn:
Raw Orokin memory plasma. Varzia's Foundry can consume Aya to create Void Relics. Find her in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars.

Location: Void Missions and Bounties
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SchismKey.descriptionZh:
未加工的奥罗金记忆等离子。瓦奇娅的铸造厂可以消耗阿耶精华来制造虚空遗物。可在火星上 Maroo 的市集里找到她。

获取地点：虚空和赏金任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ShrineFragm.name: Fate Pearl
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ShrineFragm.description:
Retrieved from the shores of a sacred fate dream.

Location: Saya's Visions on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ShrineFragm.descriptionEn:
Retrieved from the shores of a sacred fate dream.

Location: Saya's Visions on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ShrineFragm.descriptionZh:
取自神圣命运梦境的彼岸。

获取地点：萨娅的异象（地球）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.name: Sunpoint Plasma Drill Range Widget

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.descriptionZh: 提升等离子光束的距离。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.name: Sunpoint Plasma Drill Silencer Widget
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.description: Mine in peace and avoid alerting nearby enemies with this drill silencing widget.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.nameZh: 阳点等离子钻头消音改造器
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.descriptionEn: Mine in peace and avoid alerting nearby enemies with this drill silencing widget.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.descriptionZh: 用这个钻头消音改造器来和平地挖矿并避免让敌人警戒。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/TNWArchonIt.name: Archon Boreal's Shard
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/TNWArchonIt.nameZh: 执刑官诡文枭主的源力石

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/TNWArchonIt.nameZh: 执刑官混沌蛇主的源力石

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UmbraEchoes.name: Echoes Of Umbra
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UmbraEchoes.description: Injecting this fluid into a Warframe will imbue it with the ability to fight autonomously alongside the Operator. Injection requires the use of the Helminth Infirmary, and the ability wears off after 24 hours.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UmbraEchoes.descriptionEn: Injecting this fluid into a Warframe will imbue it with the ability to fight autonomously alongside the Operator. Injection requires the use of the Helminth Infirmary, and the ability wears off after 24 hours.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UmbraEchoes.descriptionZh: 将这种液体注入战甲内，使其具有与指挥官并肩作战的能力。注射需要使用 Helminth 医务间，并且该能力会在 24 小时后消失。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UtilityUnlo.name: Exilus Warframe Adapter
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UtilityUnlo.description: Fuses with a Warframe to unlock the Exilus Mod Slot.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UtilityUnlo.nameZh: 战甲特殊功能槽连接器
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UtilityUnlo.descriptionEn: Fuses with a Warframe to unlock the Exilus Mod Slot.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UtilityUnlo.descriptionZh: 融入一架战甲来解锁特殊功能槽。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ValenceAdap.descriptionZh: 使用元素恶癖来改变对手武器的元素伤害类型。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/WaterFightB.name: Nakak Pearls

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/WaterFightB.descriptionZh: 希图斯的娜卡可能会喜欢这个。她可能会拿些特别的东西来和你交易。

A volatile mushroom with an acrid odor similar to freshly detonated explosives. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus

A volatile mushroom with an acrid odor similar to freshly detonated explosives. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.name: Relay Strut Component
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.description: An integral building block in the construction of Tenno relays.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.descriptionEn: An integral building block in the construction of Tenno relays.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.descriptionZh: Tenno 中继站构造中的一个组成部分。

/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.name: Pyrus Essence
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.description: With a blazing orange hue and rigid material strength, this compound is prized by ship and station architects.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.descriptionEn: With a blazing orange hue and rigid material strength, this compound is prized by ship and station architects.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.descriptionZh: 这种化合物具有炽热的橙色色调和坚硬的材料强度，受到船舰及中继站建筑师的青睐。

/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseThr.name: Trembera Essence
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseThr.description: A highly purified mineral compound prized for its strength, resiliency, and resistance to heat. Widely used in the construction of Tenno relays.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseThr.descriptionEn: A highly purified mineral compound prized for its strength, resiliency, and resistance to heat. Widely used in the construction of Tenno relays.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseThr.descriptionZh: 高纯度矿物质化合物，因其强度，弹性和耐热性而备受推崇。广泛用于 Tenno 中继站的建造。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/CipherPlus.name: Corpus Cipher
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/CipherPlus.description: A cipher used to decode Corpus intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/CipherPlus.descriptionEn: A cipher used to decode Corpus intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/CipherPlus.descriptionZh: 一种用来破解Corpus 电脑密码的解码器。制造CORPUS 虚空钥匙组件所必要的组件。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/DataMassPlus.name: Corpus Datamass
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/DataMassPlus.description: A Corpus datamass containing encrypted intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/DataMassPlus.descriptionEn: A Corpus datamass containing encrypted intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/DataMassPlus.descriptionZh: 一个内含加密情报的 Corpus 数据块。制造CORPUS 虚空钥匙组件所必要的组件。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipChristmasifier.name: Festive Interior Decorations
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipChristmasifier.description: For a limited time, adds festive decorations to your Orbiter!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipChristmasifier.descriptionEn: For a limited time, adds festive decorations to your Orbiter!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipChristmasifier.descriptionZh: 在限定时间内，为你的轨道飞行器添加各种节庆装饰吧！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.name: Arsenal Segment
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.description: Install this segment in order to enable the Arsenal within your orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.descriptionEn: Install this segment in order to enable the Arsenal within your orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.descriptionZh: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用军械库功能。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.name: MELEE UPGRADE SEGMENT
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.description: Strengthen your Arsenal with Melee Arcanes. This segment unlocks Exilus Slots for your Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.descriptionEn: Strengthen your Arsenal with Melee Arcanes. This segment unlocks Exilus Slots for your Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.descriptionZh: 通过近战武器赋能强化你的军械库。这个模块会为你的近战武器解锁特殊功能槽。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.name: AUXILIARY FORMA CRUCIBLE
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.description: A foundry upgrade that allows two Forma to be crafted at the same time.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.descriptionEn: A foundry upgrade that allows two Forma to be crafted at the same time.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.descriptionZh: 允许在同一时间制造两个 FORMA 的铸造厂升级。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.name: Landing Craft Foundry Segment
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.description:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Foundry with the following features:

- Allows construction of Landing Craft
- Allows construction of Air Support Charges

Equip Air Support Charges in your Loadout's Gear.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.descriptionEn:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Foundry with the following features:

- Allows construction of Landing Craft
- Allows construction of Air Support Charges

Equip Air Support Charges in your Loadout's Gear.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.descriptionZh:
将轨道飞行器的铸造厂升级，可获得下列功能：

－可以制造登陆艇
－可以制造空中支持呼叫道具

在「军械库」>「携带装备」中装备「空中支援呼叫器」。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.name: Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.description: Allows the Incubator to breed Kavats.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.descriptionEn: Allows the Incubator to breed Kavats.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.descriptionZh: 可以让孵化器繁殖库娃。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.name: Incubator Segment
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.description: Install this segment to enable the pet incubator within your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.descriptionEn: Install this segment to enable the pet incubator within your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.descriptionZh: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用宠物孵化器功能。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.name: Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.description:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Incubator with the following features:

- Regress genetic aging of mature companions
- Egg incubation reduced by a day
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.descriptionEn:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Incubator with the following features:

- Regress genetic aging of mature companions
- Egg incubation reduced by a day
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.descriptionZh:
升级轨道飞行器的孵化器来获得以下功能：

- 回退受老化基因影响的成熟同伴
- 孵化时间减少一天

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.name: HELMINTH ARCHON SHARD SEGMENT
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.description: Allows the Helminth to socket Archon Shards in the current Warframe. Archon Shards permanently enhance various stats.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.nameZh: HELMINTH 执刑官源力石模块
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.descriptionEn: Allows the Helminth to socket Archon Shards in the current Warframe. Archon Shards permanently enhance various stats.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.descriptionZh: 该模块允许 Helminth 将执刑官源力石嵌入当前战甲。执刑官源力石可以永久增强多种属性。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.name: HELMINTH COALESCENT SEGMENT
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.description: Allows the Helminth to fuse Archon Shards into more powerful variants through Coalescent Fusion and Ascent Fusion.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.descriptionEn: Allows the Helminth to fuse Archon Shards into more powerful variants through Coalescent Fusion and Ascent Fusion.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.descriptionZh: 通过联结融合和升华融合，可让 Helminth 融合执刑官源力石来获得更强大的源力石变体。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.name: HELMINTH SEGMENT
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.description: Empower the Helminth in your Orbiter and unlock the transfer of new abilities to your Warframes.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.descriptionEn: Empower the Helminth in your Orbiter and unlock the transfer of new abilities to your Warframes.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.descriptionZh: 在轨道飞行器强化 Helminth，并解锁将新技能转移到战甲上的功能。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.name: HELMINTH INVIGORATION SEGMENT
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.description: Allows The Helminth to inject a Warframe with an Invigoration. Invigorations temporarily increase a Warframe's capabilities.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.descriptionEn: Allows The Helminth to inject a Warframe with an Invigoration. Invigorations temporarily increase a Warframe's capabilities.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.descriptionZh: 允许 Helminth 为战甲注入活力。活化可以暂时增加战甲的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Mods.name: Mod Fusion Segment
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Mods.description: Install this segment to enable the Mod Fusion function within the MODS terminal of your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Mods.descriptionEn: Install this segment to enable the Mod Fusion function within the MODS terminal of your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Mods.descriptionZh: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器的 Mod 终端机上以解锁 Mod 融铸功能。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.name: Railjack Cephalon
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.description: A Railjack Command Cephalon. Responsible for ships systems, mission completion and crew preservation.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.descriptionEn: A Railjack Command Cephalon. Responsible for ships systems, mission completion and crew preservation.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.descriptionZh: 航道星舰指挥中枢。负责战舰系统、任务完成以及舰员保护。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.name: RELIQUARY KEY
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.description: Resembling a Void Key, this object appears to be a perfect match for the empty slot in the Railjack's reliquary.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.descriptionEn: Resembling a Void Key, this object appears to be a perfect match for the empty slot in the Railjack's reliquary.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.descriptionZh: 与虚空钥匙类似，这个物品明显与航道星舰里圣物装置的钥匙孔相匹配。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Void.name: VOID RELIC SEGMENT
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Void.description: Install this Void Relic Segment in your Orbiter to begin opening Void Relics. Void Relics contain valuables that are only determined when opened in Void Fissure missions. Void Relics can be obtained as mission rewards.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Void.descriptionEn: Install this Void Relic Segment in your Orbiter to begin opening Void Relics. Void Relics contain valuables that are only determined when opened in Void Fissure missions. Void Relics can be obtained as mission rewards.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Void.descriptionZh: 将此虚空遗物模块安装到你的轨道飞行器上，即可开启虚空遗物。虚空遗物内含的宝物只有在虚空裂缝任务中开启后才能确定。虚空遗物可以作为任务奖励获得。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipLayerCNY.name: Spring Festival Interior Decorations
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipLayerCNY.description: For a limited time, adds festive decorations to your Orbiter!

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipLayerCNY.descriptionZh: 在限定时间内，为你的轨道飞行器添加各种节庆装饰吧！
